//: ADR-70 Tier-1 plugin hooks. Stop -> propose_closures (per-turn, fires reliably). Scripts live under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; they read/write the HOST repo (BACKLOG.md, logs/) via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. Non-blocking (exit 0). NOTE: there is deliberately NO SessionStart hook here — plugin hooks register too late for the one-shot SessionStart init event and never fire (verified 2026-06-02). Proposal SURFACING is handled by the global ~/.claude SessionStart hook (surface-closures.ps1) instead; see INSTALL.md.
